name: genpark-personal-agent-neuromuscular-reaction-time-psychomotor-skill
description: Calculates Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) attentional lapses (>= 500ms), reciprocal speed (1/RT), false starts, and estimates cumulative sleep debt hours.

tools.name: evaluate_pvt_attentional_performance
tools.description: Calculates mean RT, median RT, reciprocal speed (1/RT), lapse count (>= 500ms), and alertness tier.

parameters.reaction_times_json: string (JSON array of reaction times in milliseconds)

tools.name: estimate_sleep_debt_from_pvt_lapses
tools.description: Estimates cumulative sleep debt hours and impairment tier from PVT lapses.
